newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Gaming panel okays Hilton-Bally deal.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Gaming panel okays Hilton-Bally deal.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Thursday said the Nevada Gaming Commission approved Hilton Hotel Corp's merger with Bally Entertainment.
In a statement, Hilton said the merger is expected to be completed by the end of the year. Hilton previously announced plans to acquire Bally Entertainment in a deal worth almost $3 billion.

Two large institutional shareholders, Tower Investment Group of Tampa, Fla. and Executive Life of New York had opposed the merger and filed suit in Delaware against Bally Entertainment, Bally's Grand and Hilton regarding Bally's August sale of the Paris Casino-Resort to Bally Entertainment.
The suit charges the parties with breach of fiduciary duty.
